speak.title: Role-play: which language for a difficult talk?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your company works in English. A colleague made a mistake with some figures and you need to talk about it. You want to speak English so the whole team can follow. Ask why your colleague disagrees, then look for a deal.

b.text: You made the mistake and you want to be honest about it. You'd rather explain it in your first language, because you feel more like yourself. Say why, and suggest another way to do it.

phrases: I'd feel more comfortable in my own language.
That's fair, but the others won't understand.
Could we start in English and switch if you need to?
I don't feel like myself when I speak English.
What if we asked someone to translate?
We're both trying to be honest, so let's find a way.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: which language did you choose, and did you reach a deal?
